title: Matching service v0.3 status
text:
Hey Wop,

Quick update on the matching service before Thursday.

v0.3 is on the staging server. The big change is that groups are now built from three signals instead of one: shared courses, overlapping free time, and preferred study style (quiet, discussion, or exam cram). In tests with the fake Westbrook dataset, 87% of students got a group of 3 to 5 people within a minute.

Still open:
- Students with only one course end up in groups that are too big. I have a fix in progress.
- The API sometimes takes 4 seconds to respond when more than 200 students are matching at once. It needs to be under 1 second for launch.

All of this is tracked as issues in the pairly-api repo on GitHub. I'll link the important ones in the weekly sync notes.

Daniel Ortiz
CTO, Pairly
